name: Treant Muisek
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The wandering forest walkers that can be found meandering through the forest are our next target, adventurer. Night elves have enlisted treants as allies to fight against the horde. Their movement may be slow, but their role as protectors is undeniable.

Soon we will be able to use this power for our own benefit.

Find 3 wandering forest walkers; kill them, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them.
narrative.objectives: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our muisek collection is almost complete.
narrative.requestItemsText: Were you able to capture the wandering forest walkers?

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 45 to 50, 29,325 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
